findings.summary: los_sky omitted negative transverse screen-eigenvalue guard (min_eig < -1e-9 * min_i) and recoil::trial aborted instead of bisecting when SDIRK2 hit stage nonpositivity (R_min = -0.2071).
findings.r111_resolution: Fixed in BASS R111 commit: added min_eig < -1e-9 * min_i check to los_sky, separated nonfinite vs nonpositive checks in to_normal, added Ok(None) bisection fallback in recoil::trial for Sdirk2 stage nonpositivity, and added regression tests.

findings.summary: Handoff claims full byte-for-byte R109 reproduction, whereas modes.tsv/cl.tsv/diagnostics.tsv are byte-identical while run.txt unconditionally appends 10 new R110 provenance keys. Also RESULTS_KO.md writes '+50% relative to 2nd order' at Lya where (exact-second)/second = +101.12% (2nd order underestimates exact by 50.28%). Test count is 189 (173 unit + 16 integration) + 3 example tests = 192 total.
findings.r111_resolution: Documented repository-wins differences transparently in F0 review, R111/RESULTS_KO.md, and final report without rewriting R110 history.

findings.r111_resolution: F3 invoked run_highl_atlas.py with explicit fresh paths in ~/Downloads/htt_r111/; added --member-prefix (default 'recoil_') to commander_native.py and added tests/obsstat/test_r111_commander_native.py.

findings.summary: HyRec n_H0 (0.18971712 m^-3, m_H convention) differs by +0.0541% from REI AX08 (0.18981985 m^-3, m_p convention); R110 Part B used duration=7.0 (z=0.003982), dust_fraction=0.75 (exact 0.75668), and omitted +0.685 in Omega_Lambda denominator.
findings.r111_resolution: C1/C2 explicitly record both n_H0 anchors and quantify the +0.0541% z<=20 optical depth sensitivity; C1/C3 use exact duration=ln(1+z_emit), exact matter/(matter+rad) dust_fraction, and exact Omega_Lambda.

findings.summary: bass_ionization::merge allowed z_low == 0.0 (causing 0/0 NaN and duplicate eta); rec(z=20) knot dropped so rec(z=21) bridges to rei(z=20); unchecked CSV indexing in example.
findings.r111_resolution: Fixed in REI R111 commit: reject z_match <= 0 in Continuation::xe, skip continuation cleanly when z_low == 0.0 in merge, replace unchecked CSV indexing with safe .get().ok_or()?, and document single-owner z=20 bridge behavior.

findings.summary: run.txt logged required_initial_q_over_E using initial_lie_node(ic) (omega_lambda=0) instead of sol.history[0].node.
findings.r111_resolution: Fixed in BASS R111 commit to pass &sol.history[0].node.

findings.summary: analyze_rings lacked library-level Nyquist guard (n_phi >= 2*lmax+1) and used 1.0 - z*z instead of (1.0 - z)*(1.0 + z).
findings.r111_resolution: Fixed in BASS R111 commit with regression test in r110_replay_los.rs; analyze_rings uses (1.0 - z)*(1.0 + z) when |z| > 0.99999 so F3 l<=48 Gauss-Legendre rings remain bitwise identical to R110 RESULTS/HIGHL_ATLAS.json (32/32 SHA-256 match).
Recorded as non-blocking API note; external callers use CLI or explicit struct initialization.

findings.r111_resolution: Fixed in REC R111 commit: delegate tau0 < 1.0 to tau0 * sobolev_escape_average, document baryon-rest-frame contract, add thin-depth test.
